notes:
Shared contract for Raft's first-party action cards (botiverse/slock packages/shared/src/actionCardSpec.ts; this file is pinned by actionCard.v1.vector.sha256). Compare everything as JSON values: key order is irrelevant, and an absent key differs from a null one.
cards[]: parse `card` in read mode (what a client accepts) and in emit mode (what a server may send; clients need not implement it). `read`/`emit` give the verdict. For read: accept, `parsed` is the card after the read parse: defaults filled in (Stack direction column, wrap false; Text tone default, mono false; Badge tone neutral; Notice tone info; Button emphasis secondary), unknown envelope keys, unknown icons and unknown locale keys dropped, unknown action kinds as {kind: unsupported, originalKind}, unknown open intents as {kind: unsupported, originalKind: open, originalIntent}, unknown field types as {type: unsupported, originalType, name}. `strip[set]` is stripActionCardSpec(parsed, capabilitySets[set]): null without card.v1.
Rejecting a card means the client shows the legacy presentation. The 24576-byte limit is emit only (JSON.stringify of the parsed card, UTF-8); clients do not measure.
Lengths are Unicode code points (an astral emoji is 1). Ids are lowercase canonical UUIDs. Integers are safe integers (|n| <= 2^53 - 1); vectors never write a fraction or an exponent. Timestamps are strict RFC 3339 UTC on a date that exists; Duration compares at millisecond precision. Navigate URLs: https, no user info, no explicit port other than the default, no fragment, a dotted host that is not an IP literal, at most 2000 UTF-16 units (WHATWG URL parsing).
A raw JSON key __proto__, constructor or prototype is refused wherever a card uses names as keys (element ids, confirm and form ids, param names, field names).
Templates are read left to right: {{ and }} are a literal brace, {name} a placeholder, any other brace makes the Msg invalid. Every placeholder in every kept locale's template needs a param.
formValues[]: parse `form` as a FormSpec in read mode, then run the value checks in client and in server mode; `client`/`server` are the exact issue lists. At most one issue per field, in field order; then (server) unknown names sorted by UTF-16 code units. Blank = only U+0009-U+000D, U+0020, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000-U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000, U+FEFF.
messages[]: pick the template for `locale` (else en) and fill in params: strings as is, integers as base-10 digits, EntityRefs as {ref} segments; adjacent text merged, empty text dropped.

formValues.name: empty
formValues.note: Nothing submitted: the required fields report required; missing optional fields are not provided.

formValues.name: blank_strings
formValues.note: Blank (only U+0009-U+000D, U+0020, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000-U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000, U+FEFF) is empty for required; empty arrays too.

formValues.name: not_blank_controls
formValues.note: U+0085 and U+001C are not blank (Kotlin's trim would remove them).

formValues.name: too_long_code_points
formValues.note: too_long counts code points of the raw string: 10 emoji fit, a 6-character body does not.

formValues.name: too_many
formValues.note: Arrays over the effective max: maxItems 2; a single picker takes 1.

formValues.name: wrong_types
formValues.note: Wrong JSON types: invalid_format on the server; the client leaves them to the server.

formValues.name: invalid_option
formValues.note: A Select value that is no option (server only).

formValues.name: bad_ids
formValues.note: Picker ids that are not lowercase UUIDs or repeat (server only).

formValues.name: unknown_fields
formValues.note: Unknown names (server only), after the fields, sorted by UTF-16 code units.

formValues.name: values_not_object
formValues.note: values must be an object: the server reports one form-level issue; the client checks as if nothing was submitted.

formValues.name: unsupported_field_skipped
formValues.note: An unsupported field (read mode) is skipped; its name is not unknown.

formValues.name: optional_select_empty
formValues.note: An empty Select that is not required is not provided.
